incidents.name: Allbridge BSC pool spot-price manipulation
incidents.notes: The swap pool behaved as designed; after flash-loaning enough BUSD/USDT to become effectively the sole liquidity provider, the attacker used swaps to skew the pool's own balance-ratio price and then deposited and withdrew against that skewed spot price to extract more than was put in.

sources.ref: onchain review: pool proxy 0x312bc7eaaf93f1c60dc5afc115fccde161055fb0 created 2022-04-18 by 0x8c6644415b3f3cd7fc0a453c5be3d3306fe0b2f9 (Allbridge deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0xc578d755cd56255d3ff6e92e1b6371ba945e3984; 1 EIP-1967 Upgraded event on 2022-08-31 to implementation 0x2c3c340233338d875637304b06f4f6faf9bebd20, giving a 213-day code age; separate from the 2026 Allbridge CCTP incident already in this dataset (different chain and contract)
